We're ready to help you start your upcoming DIY project.Your local hardware store has everything you need to get your car, home, and yard ready for the cold weather. We are your one-stop shop for leaf blowers, weather stripping, snow brushes, pipe insulation, and other must-have, cold-weather essentials that keep you prepared and protected this winter. Find what you need stocked on the shelves at your local S Riding Home Depot or get it straight to your door with our fast, free delivery. Download The Home Depot product locator app and talk with an online associate to get immediate assistance — or use the app to start any returns you have. We make home improvement easy from every angle.Community involvement is important to us at The Home Depot. Since 2011, The Home Depot Foundation has invested more than $500 million in veteran causes and improved over 60,000 veteran homes.You can find us southwest of the intersection of Route 50 and Highway 606, at South Riding Market Square. Drop by today and see what's new. Remember to check our local ad before you arrive to know which items are on promotion.Sincerely,Your S Riding Store TeamFrequently Asked Questions About Your StoreIs outdoor power equipment on sale for Spring Black Friday 2026?The Home Depot Spring Black Friday Sale is back and better than ever. Save big on home decor and bath goods, including bathroom vanities. Proper storage and organization gives you spring cleaning freshness all year, and a new ceiling fan keeps air moving in your home as temps rise. Now is the time to start DIY projects by taking advantage of low prices on tools. You can embrace energy-efficient living with updated appliances, too. This spring sale runs from April 9th through 22nd, so shop fast.How can I prepare my home for fluctuating spring temperatures?Make certain your home is set for spring temperature shifts by replacing or repairing faulty components of your hardscaping and home. If water gets inside the cracks, you could be in for a headache. Check cinder blocks and brick for cracks, and ensure indoor ceiling tiles are free from water damage. On your home's exterior, examine metal roofs or roof shingles for rust or damage that may let water in. Keep gutters fully functional to prevent excess water from seeping beneath your shingles when storms arrive. Lastly, vinyl siding and chimney caps should be changed out if they're badly weathered.Do you carry large moving boxes?Make storage or moving easier by picking up a variety of moving boxes. We've got the sizes you're looking for, including specialty ones like TV and wardrobe boxes. Cushion your items with moving blankets and bubble cushion to ensure your belongings make it safely. Remember to check out our rental moving trucks if you need those, too.Should I get an inverter generator or a portable generator?Restore electricity in your home even after severe weather takes it out. We've got the options you need when searching for a generator for sale. Inverter generators are quieter and cleaner than traditional portable generators. They'll adjust to the required load, making less noise when they create less power. When exploring different generators, keep in mind that portable generators cost less and generate more electricity than inverter generators, but they're louder and heavier. For safety purposes, always run your generators outdoors, away from windows and doors.Do you have wired or wireless doorbell cameras?Enjoy privacy, peace of mind, and safety with a wired or wireless doorbell camera. No more peeking through a window when you can view animal or human visitors in real time. Some doorbell cameras even let you speak to whoever is at the door via your phone, a useful interaction to scare off potential porch pirates or talk to delivery people. Several cameras integrate with your smart home app or hub to give you flexible accessibility. Choose to save video clips for future reference as needed.Does the S Riding Home Depot offer Curbside Pickup?Yes, you can pick up Curbside Orders from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. with The Home Depot app. Select "Curbside with The Home Depot App" at checkout when you shop eligible Store Pickup items. We'll let you know via text or email when your order is ready at the store. Bring a valid, government-issued photo ID with you.Picking up your Curbside Order: 1. Download The Home Depot App.2. Before you get to the store, use the link in your "Ready for Pickup" text message or email to tell us you're on the way via the app.3. After you get to the store, park in a designated Curbside Pickup spot, which is usually located near the front of the store.4. Check in through the app to tell us you've arrived.5. Wait for us to bring out your order and load it into your vehicle.Learn more about Curbside Pickup.Recycling at The Home DepotPLASTIC BAG RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Plastic grocery bags, plastic wrap, and film plasticCOMPACT FLUORESCENT BULB RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Unbroken indoor/outdoor compact fluorescent bulbsRECHARGEABLE BATTERY RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Undamaged rechargeable batteries used in power tools, cell phones, and laptopsNickel Cadmium (Ni-Cd), Lithium Ion (Li-ion), Small Sealed Lead Acid (SSLA/Pb), Nickel Metal Hydride (Ni-MH), Nickel Zinc (Ni-Zn)The Home Depot's core values are based on doing the right thing for our associates and customers.
